I noticed that these accounts may continue to pop up here. If you run from linux, here is an one-liner for you to probe sequential accounts:

seq -f "TrumpNPC%03g" 0 10 | while read n; do wget -qO- "https://voat.co/ajaxhelpers/userinfo/$n" | grep -io 'member for [^<]\{1,\}' | sed "s/^/$n: /g"; done

You can change the TrumpNPC to whatever the name. The %03 sets n digits, 0 10 sets range [0,10]. It is that simple and it will produce a line for each account probed:

TrumpNPC001: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC002: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC003: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC004: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC005: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC006: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC007: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC008: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC009: Member for 11 days.
TrumpNPC010: Member for 11 days.

If you want to output it to a log file, just append | tee -a /path/to/log/file. The -a means appending to text file and can be omitted to overwrite existing file.
